hebrewText: וָֽ/אוֹצִ֤יא אֶת אֲבֽוֹתֵי/כֶם֙ מִ/מִּצְרַ֔יִם וַ/תָּבֹ֖אוּ הַ/יָּ֑מָּ/ה וַ/יִּרְדְּפ֨וּ מִצְרַ֜יִם אַחֲרֵ֧י אֲבוֹתֵי/כֶ֛ם בְּ/רֶ֥כֶב וּ/בְ/פָרָשִׁ֖ים יַם סֽוּף

tokens.bdb: to go (causatively, bring) out, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively, direct and proxim.
tokens.kjv: [idiom] after, appear, [idiom] assuredly, bear out, [idiom] begotten, break out, bring forth (out, up), carry out, come (abroad, out, thereat, without), [phrase] be condemned, depart(-ing, -ure), draw forth, in the end, escape, exact, fail, fall (out), fetch forth (out), get away (forth, hence, out), (able to, cause to, let) go abroad (forth, on, out), going out, grow, have forth (out), issue out, lay (lie) out, lead out, pluck out, proceed, pull out, put away, be risen, [idiom] scarce, send with commandment, shoot forth, spread, spring out, stand out, [idiom] still, [idiom] surely, take forth (out), at any time, [idiom] to (and fro), utter.
tokens.explanation: yatsa — sair, partir, nascer, brotar, emergir

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.bdb: father, in a literal and immediate, or figurative and remote application
tokens.kjv: chief, (fore-) father(-less), [idiom] patrimony, principal. Compare names in 'Abi-'.

tokens.bdb: Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt
tokens.explanation: Mitsrayim — Egito. A terra das "duas margens" do Nilo

tokens.bdb: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: abide, apply, attain, [idiom] be, befall, [phrase] besiege, bring (forth, in, into, to pass), call, carry, [idiom] certainly, (cause, let, thing for) to come (against, in, out, upon, to pass), depart, [idiom] doubtless again, [phrase] eat, [phrase] employ, (cause to) enter (in, into, -tering, -trance, -try), be fallen, fetch, [phrase] follow, get, give, go (down, in, to war), grant, [phrase] have, [idiom] indeed, (in-) vade, lead, lift (up), mention, pull in, put, resort, run (down), send, set, [idiom] (well) stricken (in age), [idiom] surely, take (in), way.
tokens.explanation: bo — vir, ir, entrar, chegar, avançar em direção a algo

tokens.bdb: a sea (as breaking in noisy surf) or large body of water; specifically (with the article), the Mediterranean Sea; sometimes a large river, or an artifical basin; locally, the west, or (rarely) the south
tokens.enLiteralWord: a sea  or large body of water; specifically
tokens.explanation: yam — mar, lago, oceano, ocidente (o mar fica a oeste)
tokens.explanationEn: a sea  or large body of water; specifically

tokens.bdb: to run after (usually with hostile intent; figuratively (of time) gone by)
tokens.kjv: chase, put to flight, follow (after, on), hunt, (be under) persecute(-ion, -or), pursue(-r).

tokens.bdb: a Mitsrite, or inhabitant of Mitsrajim
properly, the hind part; generally used as an adverb or conjunction, after (in various senses)
tokens.kjv: after (that, -ward), again, at, away from, back (from, -side), behind, beside, by, follow (after, -ing), forasmuch, from, hereafter, hinder end, [phrase] out (over) live, [phrase] persecute, posterity, pursuing, remnant, seeing, since, thence(-forth), when, with.
tokens.explanation: achar — depois, após, atrás, em seguida

tokens.bdb: father, in a literal and immediate, or figurative and remote application
tokens.kjv: chief, (fore-) father(-less), [idiom] patrimony, principal. Compare names in 'Abi-'.

tokens.bdb: a vehicle; by implication, a team; by extension, cavalry; by analogy a rider, i.e. the upper millstone
tokens.kjv: chariot, (upper) millstone, multitude (from the margin), wagon.

tokens.bdb: a steed (as stretched out to a vehicle, not single nor for mounting ); also (by implication) a driver (in a chariot), i.e. (collectively) cavalry
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a steed (as stretched out to a vehicle
tokens.enLiteralWord: a steed (as stretched out to a vehicle
tokens.explanation: a steed (as stretched out to a vehicle
tokens.explanationEn: a steed (as stretched out to a vehicle
